evidence.summary: China South Industries Group describes itself as a core force of China’s defence science, technology and industry and a centrally run military-industry enterprise whose mission is to strengthen the armed forces, and traces its history to the Fifth Ministry of Machine-Building and the ordnance industry ministry.
It describes itself as a key state-owned enterprise administered directly by the central government.
